tryon.title: Virtual try-on
tryon.subtitle: Upload a photo of the back of your hand, then pick a design.
tryon.upload: Upload a photo of your hand
tryon.uploadHint: Back of the hand, fingers spread, in good light against a plain background.
tryon.noHands: We couldn't find a hand in this photo. Try one where your whole hand is visible, fingers spread, in good light.
tryon.palm: It looks like your palm may be facing the camera. For best results, photograph the back of your hand.
tryon.detectFail: Hand detection failed to load. Check your connection and try again.
tryon.tip: Tip: tap a nail to select it, and drag to move it.
tryon.aiDesc: Generates a photo-realistic version of this design on your hand. Adjust the nails in the preview first. It takes up to a minute.
tryon.aiConsent: I agree to send this photo to the studio's server and its AI provider to generate the image. The result is kept for {{days}} days. Your original photo is not stored.
tryon.aiDisclaimer: AI-generated preview. Real polish may look slightly different. Only your nails were changed; the rest is your original photo.
tryon.privacy: The instant preview runs entirely in your browser and your photo is not uploaded. Only the optional AI photo sends it to the server.
